item.description: First public release of Beacon. Beacon is a macOS menu bar app. It shows unread GitHub activity, pull requests that need your review, and your own open pull requests. - The token comes from `gh` and stays on the Mac. Beacon talks only to `api.github.com`. - Review filters live in the panel. The config file is `~/.config/beacon/config.json`. - Signed updates. The app checks for them once a day.
